# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.59

- **Text near the gutter is no longer clipped, and wide dark border bands are removed** from the content box: a dark strip along the spine, page edge or scanner lid (12–15 % of the page) no longer widens the content box or leaves a black bar in the output; a narrow column of real text next to the border (line numbers, a gloss) is no longer thrown away as a shadow. Tested on synthetic pages only (shadow gradients, dark strips, ragged text); thresholds not yet confirmed on a large set of real photos.
- **PDF size target (`--target-size` and the window option)** now also lowers the resolution of colour and grey pages when JPEG quality alone cannot reach the target (never below 150 dpi, quality floor 40; 1-bit pages are never touched). When the target cannot be met, the reason is reported (CLI: warning on stderr; window: status bar, in English). The estimate comes from at most 6 pages, so the final size can differ a little from the target.
